About AlphaSense: 

The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making. With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients’ own research content.

The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S&P 500. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!

About the Role

The Manager, Customer Success Operations is a critical role within our Revenue Operations team, developing key enabling tools, streamlining processes, and acting as a true partner to our Customer Success organization, including Account Managers, Customer Success Managers and Support teams. You'll support our tools and processes with the overall goal of improving productivity and efficiency across the CS team, and you'll have a direct hand in driving our core KPIs around adoption, retention, and growth given how closely you'll partner with Customer Success leadership.

About the Team

The Customer Success - Revenue Operations team at AlphaSense drives productivity and improves efficiency for our account managers, CSMs, implementation specialists, support specialists, and leadership. We create and implement operational reporting and analytics, improve processes, and enable strategic initiatives that impact the revenue organization. At our core, we are a dynamic team of highly driven self-starters who are passionate about operations and thrive in a fast paced, challenging environment.

What You'll Do

  • Domain Expertise: Apply deep working knowledge of customer success and account management to guide how Customer Success Operations supports the broader CS org. Exposure to pre-sales and application specialist functions is a plus.

  • Program & Process Operationalization: Support the operating model, cadence, and governance for our roadmap of strategic customer projects, and optimize existing Customer Success processes to ensure scalability as we grow.

  • CS Metrics Ownership: Own the definitions, methodology, and standards behind our core Customer Success metrics, including NRR, GRR, renewal rate, and usage and engagement KPIs, ensuring consistency across reporting and business reviews.

  • Technology & Workflow: Support our Customer Success tool strategy across systems like Salesforce, Gainsight, Clari, Gong, and Tableau, executing on priorities identified by CS leadership.

  • Firefighting & Escalation: Act as an escalation point for operational issues, whether a broken workflow, data discrepancy, or urgent tooling issue, and drive fast, durable resolution.

  • Relationship Building: Develop strong relationships with the Customer Success team to understand and implement best practices, focusing on where they lack visibility or see gaps in process.

  • Scale & Repeatability: Build the playbooks, templates, and standards needed to expand customer programs from a handful of accounts to full coverage across strategic segments.

  • Data Partnership: Partner with the Senior Manager, Customer Success Operations on the KPI trackers, dashboards, and impact reporting that make each program measurable.

  • Reporting: Create and optimize reporting and dashboards, including attainment, trends, and on demand dashboards. Support data governance practices, consistent source of truth, clean hierarchy data, accurate field population, that keep our reporting trustworthy as the business scales.

Who You Are

  • 5 to 8 years of experience working within a Revenue organization, playing a key role in driving productivity for the Customer Success team.

  • Prior people management experience required.

  • Operations professional with a passion for driving productivity, improving processes, and using new technology to drive revenue at a high growth B2B SaaS company.

  • Strong understanding of core SaaS and Customer Success metrics, including NRR, GRR, renewal rate, and usage-based KPIs, with experience owning metric definitions and standards, not just reporting on them.

  • Experience optimizing and rolling out new technology, workflows, and processes within a revenue organization.

  • An ability to think strategically, act tactically, and write effectively.

  • A creative problem solver who identifies new and innovative ways to drive productivity.

  • A strong project manager who enjoys making things better.

  • Enjoys working cross-functionally and building strong relationships with stakeholders across the business.

  • Demonstrates exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail.

  • Experience with the B2B sales process and the tools it takes to succeed.

  • Bonus: experience with SQL, or a data warehouse tool such as Snowflake or BigQuery, and familiarity with a BI platform such as Tableau.

jobs.title: Associate Product Operations Manager
jobs.jd_full:
We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Associate Product Operations Manager to support our Product organization in improving operational efficiency, cross-functional alignment, and consistency in how work moves through the Product Development Lifecycle (PDLC). Working closely with, and at the direction of, the Senior Product Operations Manager and Product Leadership team, this role will execute the day-to-day tactics that keep our Product Operating Model running smoothly, while building the experience and judgment to take on greater ownership over time.

  • Align: work closely with the Product Leadership, Senior Product Operations Manager, Product Managers, and cross-functional business partners to help ensure product work is clearly understood, decisions are communicated effectively, and teams stay aligned on priorities, dependencies, and readiness.
  • Enable: Help provide product teams with the means to complete routine and strategic tasks as efficiently as possible, by supporting key processes, maintaining tools and workflows, and bringing structure to how work is prepared, reviewed, and tracked.
  • Improve: Support continuous, iterative improvement of how teams work by helping identify bottlenecks, reducing time spent on non-core product activities, and reinforcing the systems, governance, and operating rhythms that support high-quality product work.

Duties & Responsibilities

Product Operations is a multifaceted function that focuses on improving how the Product organization operates day to day, driving cross-functional collaboration, and enabling product teams to focus on what they do best: build great products. This role is a mixture of hands-on execution and support for continuous improvement, working under the direction of the Senior Product Operations Manager and Product Leadership team. In this role you will be responsible
for:

  • Product Operating Model and Product Development Life Cycle (PDLC) Support: Support the flow of work from intake through discovery, assessment, planning, and delivery by helping ensure requests are complete, handoffs are clear, and the right information is available at the right time.
  • Intake and Initiative Readiness: Support the intake process by serving as a first line of review for incoming requests. Work with stakeholders to gather required inputs and help ensure work is ready for Product review and decision-making.
  • Operating Rhythm and Meeting Support: Help prepare, coordinate, and, where appropriate, facilitate recurring forums such as Weekly Business Reviews, roadmap reviews, stakeholder meetings, and leadership sessions. Ensure materials are organized, decisions are captured, and follow-up actions are tracked to completion.
  • Tools and Workflow Optimization: Maintain the product management tech stack, including workflow hygiene, documentation practices, and reporting accuracy, and flag opportunities to improve transparency and usability across Product and cross-functional teams.
  • Governance and Process Support: Support key operating processes including compliance reviews, cross-functional readiness, and other recurring governance needs that help the business interact effectively with Product.
  • Cross-functional Project and Program Support: Support the execution of select cross-functional initiatives directed by the Senior Product Operations Manager and Product Managers, helping track alignment on scope, timelines, dependencies, and risks across teams.
  • Data-informed Execution: Help gather and organize data, reporting, and operational insights to support the Senior Product Operations Manager and Product Leadership in identifying trends and informing process improvements.
  • Iterative Improvement: Help ensure product operating processes, frameworks, and methodologies remain practical and fit for purpose. Support the rollout of improvements as directed, with a bias toward progress over perfection.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Support open communication and help facilitate alignment between Product, Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Marketing, and other stakeholders, ensuring teams are working effectively toward common goals.
  • Team Support: Support onboarding, training, and documentation efforts led by the Senior Product Operations Manager and Product Leadership, helping build repeatable ways of working across the Product Organization.

Requirements

  • Experience: 2-5 years in product operations, program management, project management, product management, or a similar role, ideally within a technology or product-focused organization.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. Equivalent practical experience is also welcomed.

Skill Set

Product Operations is a strategic support function for the business that is as much about coordinating people as it is technology and processes. The strongest candidates will be comfortable owning tactical, day-to-day operational work while building the skills to help identify ways to improve how the organization works over time.

Predominantly, candidates from product operations, program or project management, business operations, product management, business analysis, or similar roles may bring the right mix of execution, organization, and process improvement experience to the position.

  • An understanding of the full product development lifecycle (PDLC), including intake, discovery, assessment, planning, release, and cross-functional readiness processes.
  • Works iteratively and pragmatically - eager to help improve the way teams work over time without over-engineering or trying to change everything at once.
  • A logical and analytical mindset, with a developing ability to understand what can be changed, what value change can bring, and comfort using data to support recommendations.
  • An empathetic attitude to truly understand the problems you are trying to support and solve with your colleagues and stakeholders.
  • Comfort with ambiguity, resilience to change, and the ability to adapt while working across multiple priorities and teams.
  • Experience managing task management and workflow tools - e.g. Jira, Linear, Asana, Productboard, or similar platforms.
  • Ability to help maintain, organize, and refine knowledge bases and documentation structures using the most suitable information architecture and documentation solution at hand - e.g. Confluence, Notion, etc.
  • Ability to help use product, process, or operational data to support better decision-making and surface relevant insights from available reporting and analytics.
  • Experience supporting the administration, adoption, and improvement of software tools and workflows in general.
  • Comfort supporting meetings and presentations with multiple stakeholders, with growing confidence in facilitating and presenting over time.
  • Comfort working with all levels of the business - from senior leaders to individual contributors - and a willingness to make suggestions and support positive change under the direction of the Senior Product Operations Manager and Product Leadership.

Compensation

Our innovative solutions harness the power of machine learning, generative AI, and behavioral science to deliver exceptional outcomes and empower care teams to anticipate and resolve issues before they arise.

Our success in rapid scale across the globe is backed by some of the world's leading investors. At Qventus, you will have the opportunity to work with an exceptional, mission-driven team across the globe, and the ability to directly impact the lives of patients. We’re inspired to work with healthcare leaders on our founding vision and unlock world-class medicine through world-class operations. #LI-MB1

About the Role

Qventus is looking for our first dedicated Director of Revenue Operations to build the operating system behind our revenue engine.

Qventus uses AI to optimize health system operations across inpatient capacity, surgical growth, ambulatory access, and care gap closure. Following our $105M Series D led by KKR, we are scaling multi-product operations and expanding our commercial organization.

This is a foundational build role. You will unify and own the end-to-end revenue lifecycle across Marketing, Sales, and CS, including forecast integrity, pipeline architecture, territory/quota models, deal desk, and GTM systems strategy.

Reporting directly to a neutral revenue owner, you will serve as a key partner and builder with full mandate to shape the function.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end forecasting methodology, cadence, and accuracy (<10% variance to actuals).
  • Architect the pipeline funnel, stage exit criteria, governance, and velocity/conversion analytics.
  • Design and maintain the territory, quota, and compensation model across a growing AVP team and multiple product lines.
  • Stand up deal desk and pricing operations, partnering with Sales and Finance on approval thresholds and deal structure.
  • Own the GTM data architecture, governance, and single source of truth across the revenue stack.
  • Deliver GTM analytics and executive and board reporting as proactive insight, not ad hoc pulls.
  • Own the GTM systems roadmap (Salesforce, Gong, Circleback, and the broader stack), including build, consolidation, and automation decisions.
  • Oversee the tactical layer (Salesforce administration, Gong/Circleback administration, KPI pack and recurring reporting), delegating or automating it so the strategic work stays first.
  • Serve as the neutral operating partner across sales, marketing, and customer success by defining how leads are qualified and handed off, how data flows, and how the motion is measured end to end.
  • Demonstrate a genuine interest and passion for fixing healthcare delivery systems.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5 - 8+ years in Revenue Operations or Sales Operations within B2B SaaS, including 3+ years in a leadership role.
  • Proven track record building RevOps from zero (forecasting, pipeline architecture, data models).
  • Demonstrated ownership and defense of forecast accuracy and methodologies.
  • Deep hands-on Salesforce expertise in the object model, reporting, and enough data fluency to catch a bad number yourself.
  • Strong analytical skills across pipeline, conversion, and cycle-time analysis; fluency in SQL or a modern BI stack.
  • Experience designing territory, quota, and compensation models for a multi-segment or multi-product sales organization.
  • Proven ability to influence across sales, marketing, and CS without direct authority, including holding a neutral line when two functions want different answers.
  • AI fluency, with hands-on use of AI tooling to automate reporting and operational work.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with a strong presence in front of executives and board-level audiences.
  • Comfort operating in ambiguity, setting your own priorities, and defining scope rather than waiting for it.

It’s a Plus if You Have…

  • Enterprise healthcare or health system GTM experience, particularly long-cycle provider-side sales.
  • Experience supporting a PE- or growth-equity-backed company through board-grade reporting.
  • Experience with Gong, Circleback, or comparable conversation intelligence and revenue tooling.
  • Experience building the GTM operating model for a multi-product portfolio.
  • Background in consulting, finance, or analytics before moving into RevOps.
